scope: Explicit application result acknowledgements and ordered request epoch retirement, ADR-0019

build_identity.native_build_profile: release static RocksDB; CXXFLAGS=-g0; RUSTFLAGS=-C link-arg=-lstdc++

source_identity.final_changes_after_unit_collection: Documentation and network evidence checker/harness fixes only; no production, SDK, or unit-test input changes.
source_identity.live_network_evidence_location: Fresh per-attempt directories in /tmp; each run and checker closed before byte-verified copying.

deployment_evidence_checker_regressions.scope: Probe versus mutation accounting, bounded NOT_LEADER reroute, UNKNOWN non-replay, exact tenant HTTP accounting, old and normalized cancellation shapes; added to quality workflow.

membership.base_snapshot_transfer_proof: combined authoritative source/snapshot/SQL/disk evidence; no direct learner database metadata endpoint

recovery.limitations: One small-data loopback event; four probes/s, not the 500 requests/s reference load. No AZ failures, no latency-SLO or percentile-RTO claim. Build profile and exact binary hash are recorded; failures and UNKNOWN remain in the sample denominator.

nominal_schedule_timing_limit.latency_origin: nominal scheduled_ms; these early samples can understate invocation-to-result duration by up to the recorded early delta

preserved_non_successes.description: A retired archive without its recovery baseline could reach relative-tail subtraction and panic. Decode now validates baseline coverage first. Reproduction, hot/cold and with/without-tail regression, and atomic hydrate rejection are retained.
Incomplete initial exact-coverage runs and a strong-read identity regression remain in prior-failures; the final fresh whole-workspace collection is independent and complete.

Earlier retention attempts had a 98-byte contract-06 history despite later recorded requests; checkers rejected them. Cause is not established. Original files remain unchanged; only closed complete new runs count as passing.

A complete earlier run was rejected because fresh per-endpoint epoch capability GETs were counted as mutation replay. The checker now distinguishes probes from real operations and validates identity, deadline, ordering, single logical ownership and every tenant HTTP record. Original evidence and rejection retained.

A complete earlier run was rejected because the updated SDK normalizes an old cancellation to position:null, acknowledged:false. The checker now accepts exactly the legacy or normalized shape and rejects fabricated terminal proofs. Original evidence retained.
All negative authorization, capacity, mixed-version, response-loss and unavailable-object observations remain in original call and HTTP denominators.
Twelve platform errors remain among the 240 post-fault observations; no successful-only recovery denominator.

checker_fix_audit.auxiliary_audit_note: Initial collection wrapper expected the retention checker wording for both suites; history uses binary/harness identity changed. Both full checkers rejected changed inputs as intended; the wrapper expectation was corrected without altering either checker or evidence.

limitations: Single-cell profile remains 32 configured databases, 256 KiB per database, 8 MiB application state, and 128 retained requests per active window.
Only an explicitly acknowledged complete request window can retire. Unacknowledged or inaccessible cold results can prevent retirement; ordinary successful writes do not auto-acknowledge.
The 4096 cell administrative records are not retired; old S3 objects are not garbage-collected.
Upgrade stops all voters, retains original disks, and uses OpenExisting. Mixed peer generations cannot form quorum; no rolling upgrade or downgrade to old binaries.
Local loopback, process SIGKILL and small data do not establish three-AZ, power-loss, 1 GiB restore, 500 requests/s, production latency or availability targets.
Dynamic tenants, multiple cells, automatic damaged-replica provisioning, control-plane credential rotation, object GC, PITR and S3-only disaster recovery remain separate platform work.
